description: A non-ASCII string VALUE in the digest domain: {"a":"é"}, with é the single code point U+00E9. RFC 8785 serializes every code point outside the ASCII control range as is (section 3.2.2.2) and encodes the result in UTF-8 (section 3.2.4), so the digest is keccak256 over the bytes 7b 22 61 22 3a 22 c3 a9 22 7d. Until v0.5.5 the corpus carried non-ASCII in the digest domain only in keys (p14, n12), so an engine that escaped string values to ASCII before hashing passed every vector. Accepting twin of n71. Input from @Rul1an's report (issue #1).
